summary: D001 proves an unusually apt storage mechanism, but its written surface does not yet make that mechanism indispensable. The room residues are familiar shorthand for departure, the database transition replaces the whole report rather than registering a dissent within it, and the final four lines explain the WAL conceit after the artifact has already demonstrated it. Preserve the mechanism and historical pair, but do not promote this draft.

artifact_form.reason: The unchanged main database and required WAL produce genuinely different committed readings; the sidecar is structural, not decorative.

language_pressure.reason: A calendar halo, bed-foot impressions, a cup, and brass filings are legible but conventional inventories of absence.

transition_semantics.reason: Deleting and replacing every row makes the WAL an alternate hidden poem rather than a precise change contesting the base record.

closure.reason: “No change is pending / in the body of the record. / The changes are committed / beside it.” explains the mechanism instead of ending in transformed source pressure.

disclosure_survival.reason: Disclosure strengthens the artifact but exposes how much of the page depends on explaining the artifact rather than on the particulars.

specificity.reason: The residue images are concrete, yet no external vacancy or inspection vocabulary constrains them.

strengths: The database/WAL pair is a real formal dependency, not typographic simulation.
The base/committed contrast gives “vacancy” an exact record-state analogue.
The main-file hash invariant and portable sidecar receipt are technically honest.
failures: The physical traces are generic emblems of someone having left.
The logical transaction performs wholesale substitution instead of a meaningful revision inside one record.
The ending paraphrases the storage trick and spends the poem’s last pressure on explanation.
The artifact can be admired independently of the text, which is evidence that the text has not yet earned the apparatus.
revision_instruction: Preserve D001 and its exact artifact bytes. Build D002 under draft-specific paths. Use an official move-out inspection form as the base record, change only the disagreement checkbox in WAL, append the specific items, and end on the Census vacancy classification rather than an explanation of WAL.
comparison_limit: One internal later-turn cold review; not independent reader evidence.
non_claim: This internal review routes revision. It is not external uptake, admission, or evidence that D002 succeeds.
